coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, read/derived from Fig 4b and BR limits)
notes: New collider exclusion on ALP-two-photon coupling g_agamma from LEP-I Z->2gamma and Z->3gamma data (Fig 4b, photon-only coupling). Fills MeV-to-10 GeV gap up to ~90 GeV. Fig 4a shows the alternative g_aBB (hypercharge) coupling. Numerical values are approximate estimates from the figure and from stated branching-ratio limits (BR(Z->gamma pi0)<=5.2e-5, BR(Z->3gamma)<=1e-5) since precise data are only in log-log figures. Paper also includes FCC-ee and LHC 13 TeV/100 fb^-1 projections (not extracted here).
